blocks.html:
Christine Gwinnup

The Little Lady Sells Homes

I’m a Loveland-based Realtor proudly serving Northern Colorado — known for fierce negotiation, bold marketing, and an eye for opportunity. Whether you're buying your first home, upsizing, downsizing, or investing, I help people make smart, confident real estate moves across Loveland, Berthoud, Masonville, Fort Collins, Windsor, Eaton, Ault, Severance, Timnath and beyond.

I know what it feels like to move, to dream of a home that fits your life better, and to want someone who gets it. This isn’t just a job to me — it’s personal. I’m honored to guide my clients through life-changing decisions with clarity, strategy, and heart.
